title: Sedge Cloister
description: The voices speak in groups of two full bars and one shortened bar. A hushed D-minor opening becomes a close-register exchange, with the lower hand briefly moving into treble clef. The return remembers that conversation in a lower register and closes with a single shared breath.
technical_note: Keep the quarter-note pulse through each 4/4-to-3/4 change. The central LH treble-clef passage remains in the left hand. Maintain separate phrase lengths and leave the repeated short-bar silences unpedalled.

performance.note: Authored breathing, changing dialogue and independent voicing; no random timing.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
